movelist.name: Tail Whip
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Electro Ball
movelist.effect: The user adds their Speed Stat, including Combat Stages, in addition to their Special Attack when determining the damage dealt by Electro Ball. The Defender in turn subtracts both their Special Defense and Speed Stats from the damage dealt before applying Type Effectiveness.

movelist.name: Thunder Wave
movelist.effect: Thunder Wave Paralyzes the target. Targets immune to Electric Attacks are immune to Thunder Wave’s effects.

movelist.name: Play Nice
movelist.effect: Play Nice lowers the target’s Attack by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the damage and effects of Electric Type attacks. Whenever an Electric Type attack hits the Pokémon, raise their Speed by +1 Combat Stage. Defensive.

abilities.name: Surge Surfer
abilities.effect: On Electric Terrain or while under half maximum Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.
